title: enqueue() doc comment misrepresents orphan .msg handling ('retried' vs 'moved to dead/')
description: enqueue() doc comment (lines 115-116) says orphan .msg files are 'retried on the next startup scan'. The actual behavior in cleanup_orphan_msg_files is to MOVE them to dead/ — they are never retried. Operators reading the doc comment will expect the queue to self-heal orphan .msg files; instead they need to inspect dead/ and manually re-inject. The doc comment was updated in a8cfa80 but still contains this misrepresentation.
